info.title: openbarcode
info.description: Command-line barcode reader for images and PDF files (dotnet tool "openbarcode"). Pure managed code.

options.name: --formats
options.description:
Comma-separated formats to look for, e.g. qrcode,code128,ean13.
Groups: default (all but msi), all, linear, 2d.

options.name: --fast
options.description: Quicker, less thorough search (no rotation, no inversion, no try-harder).

options.name: --first
options.description: Stop at the first barcode in each image.

options.name: --dpi
options.description: Resolution for rendering PDF vector graphics (default 300).

options.name: --no-images
options.description: Do not decode images embedded in PDFs.

options.name: --no-vectors
options.description: Do not render PDF vector graphics.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Report skipped PDF images and timing on stderr.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show this help.
Exit code: 0 when at least one barcode was found, 1 when none, 2 on errors.
